description: **A finished session keeps its cap slot until someone stops it**: a `done` row held its pid past 45 s, and only `jobs sessions --stop-finished` stops it, so `--auto` can sit at a full cap of `done` rows. W46 decides whether the tick stops them. First test what state a session shows while it waits for a background task (if `done`, a stop ends live work) and how long an unstopped `done` row keeps its pid. A `failed` or `stopped` row with a pid also counts and no verb stops it. Why: At napoleon's cap of 4 the queue can stall with only a log line. Raised: W41 review round 1, Later 3, 2026-11-06
title: A finished session keeps its cap slot until someone stops it
